$Comment:
The reward for WIELDING the Sawmiller's Hatchet, not for winning it. Read that line first: this table grants an extra plank to a worker who already holds the trophy, and it can never hand the trophy over. The chase that does lives in SawmillTrophy (this pack's own copy of the RPG Stations jar table, 1 in 3000 at its floor and better with luck). Two files, two opposite questions: what it takes to EARN the hatchet, and what the hatchet is WORTH once earned. Name a table for what it pays and the pair stays unambiguous at a glance.

It is referenced from this pack's Extensions/SawmillProgression.json Bonus.Lootables beside SawmillLuckFinds and SawmillOutputLadders.

The gate is what makes this the trophy's own roll: three ANDed Conditions on the Sawmiller's Hatchet's three axes - quality 5 (Legendary), item level 50, and Woods gather power 0.55 through the Param-less hytale:tool_power form, which reads whatever gather type the station itself declares. Every one sits a notch above the chase's own gate in SawmillTrophy (quality 4, power 0.5, the vanilla Mithril hatchet's values), so no forgeable tool clears it and only the trophy itself, or a better modded tool, opens this roll at all.

No Ladder and no tiers: the whole probability sits on one visible Chance leaf. 5 percent base, rising by a tenth of a point per point of global MMO_Luck and MMO_Luck_WOODCUTTING and by a twentieth per point of MMO_Luck_CRAFTING - the same station's-own-skill-full, adjacent-skill-half weighting every scored roll in this pack uses, at a fifth of the find ladder's scale so luck sweetens the seam rather than deciding it. The 20 percent cap is reached around 150 weighted luck points. The score reads luck and the tool only, with no level term: this roll is about what is in the worker's hands, and adding levels would let a capped worker inflate a reward meant to be earned by the tool.

It closes a loop with this pack's own copy of the hatchet, which carries +25 MMO_Luck_WOODCUTTING while held: the trophy lifts its own roll from 5 to 7.5 percent the moment it is equipped.

The payoff is the MMO_Station_Sawmill_Masterwork drop table: a double helping of the offcuts every tier pays, plus a 2 percent shot at a Woodcutting XP boost token that no find tier carries. It grants no extra plank and no life essence on purpose - planks are what the two ladders in SawmillOutputLadders pay for, essence is the find ladder's currency, and this seam is the tool's own. A masterwork edge saves the material a rougher cut destroys, which is why the trophy's signature is usable offcuts rather than throughput.

All thresholds, weights and grants here are initial balance and retune freely without any engine change.
